instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Planning recap: LessonLoop Review Desk is intended to provide a controlled workflow for submitting, assigning, reviewing, and tracking lesson plans. Teachers submit plans, monitor review status, and edit only drafts or returned plans. Department Coordinators assign submissions to Curriculum Reviewers, and those reviewers work only on their assigned plans, add feedback, and approve or return the plans. Lesson content is written by teachers rather than created by the tool.

output.summary: LessonLoop Review Desk provides a controlled workflow for lesson-plan submission, assignment, review, and tracking. Teachers submit plans, monitor their status, and edit only drafts or returned plans, while Department Coordinators assign submissions to Curriculum Reviewers. Reviewers work only on assigned plans, provide feedback, and approve or return them; the tool does not create lesson content.
output.primary_goal: Provide a controlled workflow for submitting, assigning, reviewing, and tracking lesson plans.
key_capabilities: Assignment of submitted plans to Curriculum Reviewers
Permission-controlled editing of draft and returned plans
Feedback and approval or return decisions for assigned plans

instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Scoping workshop notes: The goal is a controlled workflow for lesson plan submission and review tracking. A Teacher submits plans and sees whether they are waiting, approved, or returned. A Department Coordinator assigns each submitted plan to a Curriculum Reviewer. A Curriculum Reviewer may work only on assigned plans, add feedback, and approve or return them. Teachers may edit a plan only while it is a draft or after it has been returned. Automatic creation of lesson content is excluded. The project name was not written down.

output.business_objective: Provide a controlled workflow for lesson plan submission and review tracking.
